validation: Inference-only factor returns must reproduce the frozen GPU output within 1e-6 absolute return units for every model and month.
tolerance_reason: The initial implementation check used 2e-7 and found maximum CPU-versus-GPU floating-point variation of 8.22e-7. The tolerance was fixed at 1e-6 before any sealed-period execution; this equals 0.01 basis points of monthly return.
stopping_rule: Any difference above 1e-6 blocks the sealed run.
